text: API to create custom extraction categories and attach them to an agent for structured data pulled from calls
quote: POST /agent/{agent_id}/extraction-categories — create a category (name + model) and attach it to an agent

text: Call summaries can be toggled on/off per agent via the create/update API
quote: Call summaries are an agent-level toggle: call_summary_enabled (boolean, off by default) on the agent create and update APIs

text: Agent automatically detects and switches spoken language mid-call
quote: the agent detects and switches mid-call on its own

text: Claims you can build and deploy a voice agent in under 5 minutes
quote: Build and deploy in under 5 minutes

text: Prebuilt templates can be cloned and customized for your business
quote: Clone any template and customize it for your business.

text: Supports multiple STT/TTS providers including Deepgram, Azure, ElevenLabs
quote: Bolna supports Deepgram, Azure, ElevenLabs, and more.

text: Agents can run on a single speech-to-speech model, skipping separate transcribe/synthesize steps
quote: Agents can also run on a single speech-to-speech model that hears and speaks directly, without the separate transcribe and synthesize steps.

text: Choose different voices, accents, and speaking styles for the agent
quote: You can choose different voices, accents, and speaking styles to match your brand.

text: Self-host the voice AI runtime on your own servers via Docker or Kubernetes
quote: Learn how to self-host Bolna Voice AI on your own servers using Docker or Kubernetes for secure, private, and scalable enterprise deployments.

text: No usage charges for providers you connect yourself (BYOK)
quote: We don't charge for any usage for providers that you have connected to Bolna.

text: Custom LLM support via OpenAI-compatible base_url when provider is set to 'custom'
quote: For custom llm simply keep provider in the llm_agent key as custom and add a openai compatible base_url

text: Build multi-step outreach sequences mixing voice calls, WhatsApp, API calls, waits, and retries via the API
quote: Build multi-step outreach sequences that combine voice agent calls, WhatsApp messages, API calls, waits and retries, driven entirely through the Bolna API.

text: Bring-your-own-telephony: connect any standards-compliant SIP trunk to the platform
quote: Bring Your Own Telephony (BYOT) lets you connect any standards-compliant SIP trunk to the Bolna platform.

text: Place your first call end-to-end via the API (auth, agent, call, transcript) in about five minutes
quote: Make your first Voice AI call with the Bolna API — verify your key, get an agent, place a call, and fetch the transcript in about five minutes.

text: Generate API keys for authentication from the dashboard
quote: Click the Create a new API Key button to generate your unique authentication credentials.

text: Official CLI (single Go binary) manages agents, calls, phone numbers, and batches from the terminal
quote: The Bolna CLI (bolna) is a single Go binary that lets you manage agents, calls, phone numbers, and batches directly from your terminal

text: Official MCP server lets Claude, Cursor, Windsurf or other MCP clients connect to your Bolna account
quote: Connect Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, or any MCP client to your Bolna account with the Bolna MCP server.

text: Web Call SDK connects a browser tab directly to a live voice agent conversation
quote: The Web Call SDK connects a browser tab directly to a Bolna voice agent for a live, two-way conversation.

text: Bringing your own provider keys (BYOK) removes Bolna's charge for those components
quote: When you bring your own keys (BYOK), Bolna does not charge for those components.

text: Indian data residency option for deployments requiring data to stay in India
quote: Indian data residency is available for deployments where data must remain in India.

text: Requires whitelisting three specific IPs on your server/firewall for connectivity
quote: Whitelist all three IPs on your server or firewall

text: End-to-end open source framework for building LLM-based voice conversational apps
quote: Bolna is the end-to-end open source production ready framework for quickly building LLM based voice driven conversational applications.

text: Can power thousands of inbound/outbound calls per minute with multilingual intelligence
quote: Power thousands of inbound and outbound calls every minute with human-like, multilingual intelligence
